turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Questions with did come soon. First we need the past form, because we use it to answer them.
Think about last weekend: it is finished.
Example: Today I clean my room. Yesterday I cleaned my room. I add -ed to clean.
The rule: for many verbs, add -ed to talk about a finished action.
Right: Last night we cooked rice. Wrong: Last night we cook rice.
Your turn. Write the past form.
Yesterday she ___ (open) the window.
